entries.category_description: Supply and installation of solar panels on and adjacent to private dwellings, housing and public and other buildings used for activities in the public interest
entries.code_description: Installation services of plastic pipe systems in industrial plants
entries.comment: Tabel II prov. a.10: A zero rate is applicable for the supply and installation of solar panels [panels that have the function of generating electricity from sunlight with photovoltaic cells (also known as PV cells or solar cells)] on and adjacent to private dwellings. An important condition for the 0% rate is that the panels are installed on or near a home.
